calls.title: Podcast Site Review
calls.summary: The team is finalizing the podcast platform, aiming for a launch within the next week. Key tasks include completing content integration with feedback from Yousef, addressing formatting issues, and ensuring seamless CMS integration. The platform’s design must adhere to the established system for consistency. Alongside this, a simple partner directory focused on logos and descriptions is being developed to encourage reciprocal promotion. This includes incentivizing partners to contribute content such as case studies, which will enhance visibility. The discussion also explored content cross-linking between podcasts and blogs, highlighting selected episodes to streamline access for users while maintaining design integrity. Timelines are tight, with the outreach to European partners planned before August.
calls.keywords: Podcast, Partner Directory, Content Formatting, Website Design, Collaboration, CRO Agencies
calls.action_items:
**Karen Henke**
Meet with Emmy to review podcast content and finalize any formatting changes before launch (00:35)
Coordinate with Yousef to ensure podcast site adheres to design system colors and dropdown menus for UI consistency (16:00)
Build partner directory pages based on the simple template and share with partners for feedback and updates (24:07)
Categorize partners by those with existing Growth Book site links and those without, and prepare tailored outreach emails accordingly (26:40)
Decide on inclusion of technology partners in the directory after further reflection (27:32)

**Emmy Sharp**
Update Tanner on final podcast data formatting for HTML readiness once all content is finalized (02:01)
Verify and correct bracket formatting in episode transcripts and finalize content (06:10)
Manage staging publishing options to make podcast content visible on staging but not live until ready (15:30)
Share podcast index page link with Ashley for review since it cannot be publicly viewed yet (16:00)
Ensure podcast episode summaries appear first and combine overview and notable quotes rather than separate them (10:12)

**Ashley Stirrup**
Review staging version of podcast site and provide input on style, layout, and content flow (01:19)
Consider blog content strategy for Cassandra's writing with links to favorite podcast episodes on culture, experimentation, and technical topics (12:00)
Focus partner outreach on partners who invest in joint content and reciprocal linking, filtering by client size and service level (23:00)
Create additional content such as video interviews and blogs for partners to extend their profiles on the partner directory (27:55)
Initiate video recording for Mint Minds partner once the relevant contact returns from vacation (28:12)
